dex.text: A sea serpent so long that nobody has seen both ends on the same day. Its yawns raise great waves and its breath is so foul that the gulls fly round it holding their beaks.
dex.fact: In the Orkney tale, the hero Assipattle sailed into the Mester Stoor Worm's mouth and set its liver alight with a burning peat. Its teeth fell out and became Orkney, Shetland and the Faroe Islands, and its body became Iceland.
